info.title: v2.first_mile.get_courier_delivery_tracking_number_list
info.description: Use this api to get tracking number for courier delivery method.

post.description: Use this api to get tracking number for courier delivery method.

parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is "". If data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "cursor": "\\"\\"",
    "from_date": "2024-10-01",

import requests
import json

url = "https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/first_mile/get_courier_delivery_tracking_number_list?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp"

payload=json.dumps({
  "cursor": "\"\"",
  "from_date": "2024-10-01",
  "page_size": 10,
  "to_date": "2024-10-28"
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.RPCRequest("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: first_mile_tracking_number
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The generate first-mile tracking number, value might be blank.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The logistics status for first-mile tracking number. Status could be: CANCELED CANCELING DELIVERED NOT_AVAILABLE ORDER_CREATED ORDER_RECEIVED PICKED_UP Note: NOT_AVAILABLE status means that Binding ID / First Mile Tracking Number is not yet bound with any order.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reason
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate the reason when Shopee failed to place courier order to 3PL (Kuaidi 100 supporting) or courier company cancelled the order. Note: Will be empty if status is not CANCELED.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: declare_date
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The declare date of binding ID/first-mile tracking number.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: more
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This is to indicate whether the tracking number list is more than one page. If this value is true, you may want to continue to check next page to retrieve tracking numbers.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: next_cursor
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: If more is true, you should pass the next_cursor in the next request as cursor. The value of next_cursor will be empty string when more is false.
